title: UMTHUTHUKISI WE-SDR
meta: Salary aligned with the market + typical French benefits (Health Insurance, 50% Transportation card)
html:
Indima

Umuntu ozokhethwa uzobhekana nalokhu okulandelayo:

  • Ukuklama nokuthuthukisa izixazululo zemisakazo elawulwa yisofthiwe,
  • Ukuqonda isu le-SDR, nokuletha imibono emisha,
  • Ukwakha nokunakekela izinqubo zokucubungula izithombe ezinemibandela eqinile yokusebenza kahle nokubambezeleka okuncane,
  • Ukusebenzisana nabaklami bezinto zikagesi,
  • Ukusebenzisana nabaklami, namaqembu emikhiqizo, kanye nonjiniyela bezinhlelo
  • Ukubamba iqhaza ezinqumweni zokwakheka kwezinhlelo nasecebweni lobuchwepheshe lesikhathi eside lemodemu
  • Ukubhala imibhalo yobuchwepheshe esezingeni eliphezulu nokubuyekeza ikhodi njengochwepheshe onolwazi olujulile

Amakhono Obuchwepheshe Adingekayo

  • Isisekelo esiqinile kwizibalo ze-SDR (i-aljebra yomugqa, izinguquko zezibalo, ukuphrojektha)
  • Ulwazi oluqinile lokuthuthukisa imisakazo elawulwa yisofthiwe
  • Ulwazi olusebenzayo nge-SDR kanye ne-PCB
  • Ulwazi lokusebenza ngaphansi kwemibandela yesikhathi sangempela (isikhathi esabelwe uhlaka ngalunye, ukubambezeleka, isikhathi esiphakathi kokunyakaza nokuvela kwesithombe)
  • Izilimi zokuhlela: C / Rust / ASM

Ngawe

  • Iminyaka emi-3 kuya kweyi-10 yolwazi lomsebenzi ekuthuthukisweni kwesofthiwe, ugxile kakhulu ku-SDR
  • Umlando oqinisekisiwe wokusebenza ezinhlelweni eziyinkimbinkimbi nezibalulekile kwezobuchwepheshe
  • Ukucabanga okujulile ku-SDR kanye nekhono lokuqonda amaqoqo amakhulu ekhodi esevele ikhona
  • Ukucophelela okukhulu, ukuzimela, nokunaka imininingwane, kanye nentshisekelo enkulu yokuxazulula izinkinga zobuchwepheshe ezingelula
  • Amakhono angaba yinzuzo: Ukuklama izinto zikagesi
  • Amakhono angaba yinzuzo: Iminikelo kumaphrojekthi omthombo ovulekile

Inqubo Yenhlolokhono

  1. Ucingo Lokuqala Lwemizuzu eyi-15: Ingxoxo emfushane mayelana nogqozi lwakho, nokufaneleka kwakho, nokuphendula imibuzo yakho engahlobene nobuchwepheshe.
  2. Izinhlolokhono Ezimbili Zobuchwepheshe Nomkhiqizo, Ihora Ngayinye: Ukuhlola ngokujulile indlela yakho yokuxazulula izinkinga no-CTO wethu kanye/noma nomakhi wethu oholayo wezixazululo
  3. Ukuhlangana Nethimba: Ingxoxo ekhululekile yokuqinisekisa ukuthi uzwana kahle nendlela yethu yokusebenza.

Esikunikezayo

  • Ukusebenza ngobuchwepheshe besimanje be-XR nobekhompyutha yezindawo ezinezinhlangothi ezintathu
  • Ukuphatha ngokugcwele izinhlelo zesikhathi sangempela eziyinselele kwezobuchwepheshe
  • Amaphrojekthi anobuchwepheshe obujulile futhi ayinselele engqondweni
  • Indawo yokusebenza ehlonipha ubuchule bangempela bobunjiniyela futhi egxile kwezobuchwepheshe (ayikho imihlangano engenamsebenzi noma imibiko engadingekile)
  • Ukuzimela okukhulu ekwenzeni izinqumo zobuchwepheshe
